items.title: [正面] I used to be a huge Yu-Gi-Oh! and Pokémon player,...
items.summary:
I used to be a huge Yu-Gi-Oh! and Pokémon player, totally addicted to strategy and the meta, it was driving me crazy, but this game has become my go-to for relaxation, chilling out, no pressure. The Awakener designs are simply sublime, the game's atmosphere is a unique experience, you really have to follow the lore to fully appreciate the game's potential.

For those who haven't figured it out, this game is a gacha, deckbuilding, PvE game (PvP too, but I've never tried it). It's quite generous with summons, I rarely run out of resources, but you have to be willing to play a bit.

The only flaw I find is the translation; a proper French translation would be perfect for me, as I struggle with English.

If you're looking for a niche game to pass the time, and don't want to feel like you're being ripped off by a pay-to-win system, then this game is for you.

(Translation with Google Translate, sorry if the english is weird)
